'''Wright''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]]<ref name="Lego" /> who served as a [[lieutenant]] and flew in the [[Resistance Starfighter Corps]] during its [[First Order-Resistance War|conflict]] with the [[First Order]].<ref name="Lego" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> Wright along with [[C'ai Threnalli]] went to the planet [[Jakku]] to pick up [[Poe Dameron]] after receiving his [[distress signal]] and later participated in the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]]. During this battle, Wright along with Threnalli and Threnalli's [[astromech droid]] [[R3-Z3]] were shot down and crashed on Starkiller's surface. They then fought through [[First Order]] forces and stole a speeder to make it to the landing pad, where they took an [[AAL-1971/9.1 Troop Transport]] to escape from Starkiller before its destruction.<ref name="Lego" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wright was a Resistance Pilot in [[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]], appearing in the [[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens#Escape from Starkiller Base|Escape from Starkiller Base]] DLC level. If a player were to do the Escape from Starkiller Base level first, then Wright along with Threnalli would be added in the ending cutscene of the Poe's Quest for Survival DLC level.
